name: clawbio-research
description: Three reproducible ClawBio research demonstrations: pharmacogenomics, cached variant classification and population representation. Bundled data only; no private genomic uploads or clinical validation claims.

interface.longDescription: Run three bundled research workflows and inspect their reports, missing-data handling and provenance. Requires Python execution and the listed dependencies. Demonstration data only. Research and educational use; not a medical device.
defaultPrompt: Run the synthetic ClawBio pharmacogenomics demo and explain missing-data abstention.
Run the cached ClawBio variant-classification demo and inspect its evidence audit.
Run ClawBio's synthetic population-representation demo and explain what its metrics can establish.
